text:
alex_ae: Prep for tomorrows procurement call with RegSecure. They want: 1) firm line that customer private keys never leave HSM, 2) rotation and emergency rotation SLA, 3) an estimated pricing uplift vs hosted keys for ~100k tokens/day. Need bullets + a one-pager.

rachel_sec: Short bullet: we support BYOK via HSM-proxy or cloud-KMS. We never export plaintext key material; all crypto ops happen in the customer HSM or their KMS. Can provide a redacted attestation (vendor + FIPS status).

diego_eng: Quick perf note from staging: single-region HSM proxy ~16ms median added; 95th ~40-50ms for small requests. Multi-region failover depends on egress (add 20-60ms). Will produce 1-page perf + network checklist.

maya_sre: Network checklist: allow outbound 443 to our proxy CIDRs; option for private-link/peering (longer setup); metrics collector needs one inbound ACL. Will post CIDRs and a terraform snippet by 3pm PT.

sam_legal: Contract options: (A) default no-escrow, customer owns keys and Redwood does not retain plaintext; (B) optional escrow with fees and restricted access controls. Proof-of-destruction language included. Drafting both.

alex_ae: Pricing ask follow-up: approximate uplift only. Any ranges we can share?

diego_eng: Ballpark: expect 8-15% per-token cost uplift for BYOK via HSM proxy. One-time onboarding/integration fee commonly $1.5k-$3k. Managed HSM hosting (if we host) adds recurring fees. Dedicated throughput items separate.

rachel_sec: Rotation: customer-initiated rotations via API; default recommended cadence 30-90 days. Emergency rotation supported; SOW to define max RTO for rotation.

deploy-bot: staging/byok-proxy deployed 449 https://staging.redwood.ai/ops/instances/ready-123 (creds in secure channel)

alex_ae: Great. Deliverables: redacted attestation + 2-sentence blurb (rachel), 1-pager perf/network (diego/maya), two contract snippets (sam), pricing ranges (diego). Please drop by EOD so I can send the procurement note. Thanks!
